scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:core" "npm run start:about-us" "npm run start:our-services" "npm run start:maintenance" "npm run start:profesional" "npm run start:generic-list"
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run setup && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:static: npm run build:prod && npm run copy:static
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/static && cp -r packages/core-shell/dist/* dist/static/ && for pkg in packages/*/dist/remoteEntry.js; do cp "$pkg" dist/static/$(basename $(dirname $(dirname "$pkg")))-$(basename "$pkg"); done
scripts.setup: npm config set registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
